title: Registration form with CSS box model and focus styles
brief: Design a user registration form using HTML input controls, then style it with CSS selectors, the box model and focus styles.
steps: Wrap everything in a <form> with an action and method
Group the fields in a <fieldset> with a <legend>
Add a text field, an email field and a password field
Every field needs a <label> whose for matches the input's id
Add a radio group (same name) and a submit button
Style a class with padding, border and border-radius
Set * { box-sizing: border-box }
Give inputs a visible :focus style

checks.label: a label's for matches an id
checks.hint: Each label's for must match its input's id.

checks.label: radios share one name
checks.hint: All radios in a group need the SAME name.

checks.label: a class rule sets padding
checks.hint: Style a class with padding, e.g. .card { padding: 20px; }

checks.label: a class rule sets a border
checks.hint: Add a border in the same class rule.

checks.label: has a focus style
checks.hint: Add input:focus { ... } - the syllabus names focus styles.

solution:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Registration</title>
  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 20px; }

    .card {
      max-width: 460px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px;
      border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff;
    }

    label { display: block; margin: 14px 0 5px; font-weight: 600; }
    input, select { width: 100%; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ccc;
                    border-radius: 8px; }
    input:focus, select:focus {
      outline: none; border-color: #E07B1E;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(224,123,30,.2);
    }
    button { margin-top: 18px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0;
             border-radius: 9px; background: #E07B1E; color: #fff; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form class="card" action="/register" method="post">
    <fieldset>
      <legend>Create your account</legend>

      <label for="nm">Full name</label>
      <input type="text" id="nm" name="name" required maxlength="60">

      <label for="em">Email</label>
      <input type="email" id="em" name="email" required>

      <label for="pw">Password</label>
      <input type="password" id="pw" name="password" minlength="8" required>

      <label>Year of study</label>
      <label><input type="radio" name="year" value="1" checked> First</label>
      <label><input type="radio" name="year" value="2"> Second</label>
    </fieldset>

    <button type="submit">Register</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>
note: The box model and focus styles are named in the syllabus for this experiment, so the examiner looks for them specifically.
